brief: @buildthis.bisks.net build a site that lets me authenticate with my Bluesky account, and then lists all my moderation lists publicly so that other authenticated Bluesky users can request to have themselves removed or added from said lists. It should provide a way to bulk add/remove all the requests
note: built velvetrope: sign in, browse anyone's public mod lists, and request to be added or removed — every request and every owner decision is a real record, verified off the author's own PDS.
